events.text: Baaji, Anjali madam ke blouse kab uthane hain?
Aapka 8 meter georgette aa gaya. Purana ₹3,200 baaki hai.
Baaji, Salma Begum ka lehenga 60% ho gaya. Zari ka dhaaga khatam, 2 reel chahiye.
Fatima ji, trial kab rakhenge? Shaadi 6 tareekh ko hai, tension ho raha hai.
Ammi tuition ke baad Nida ke ghar jaungi, 7 tak aa jaungi.
Jumme ko lunch pe aa rahi hoon, biryani bana rahe na?
Hi Fatima, can my 3 blouses be ready by Tuesday? I have a conference.
Bijli ka bill ₹2,340 aaya hai, pay kar dena.
Thyroid reports normal. Continue Thyronorm 50 every morning.
